title: Aggregate jobs with stable required-check names
summary: Adds aggregate jobs `all` to `tests.yml` (`Tests · all lanes`) and `docs.yml` (`Docs · lint and build`) that need every job of the workflow, run `if: always()` and fail unless all needs succeeded; creates `.github/rulesets/required-checks.json` with the contexts of knowledge/supply-chain#checks (without `Security · all gates`, added by P2.1); removes `paths` filters from `pull_request` triggers of required workflows.
why: P0-A needs required checks that exist on every PR under fixed names; matrix job names change with the matrix. Risks: an aggregate without `if: always()` is skipped when a need fails and GitHub treats skipped as success for required checks — the aggregate must run and fail; a `paths` filter leaves a required check pending forever.

include: `tests.yml` job `all` (needs test, test-db-matrix, test-replica, test-redis, coverage, consumer-fixture)

reads.why: Branch, commits, owner WIP, frozen-contract stop rule, owner gates, evidence

rules: Aggregate step reads results through `env: RESULTS: ${{ join(needs.*.result, ' ') }}` and loops in bash (W10).
guidance:
Aggregate step body:
```bash
set -Eeuo pipefail
for result in $RESULTS; do
  [[ "$result" == success ]] || { echo "::error::a required job ended with $result"; exit 1; }
done
```
When `release.yml` calls `tests.yml`, the aggregate runs too; the release graph needs are unchanged.

validation.cmd: python3 -c 'import yaml,glob,json,sys; names={v.get("name") for f in glob.glob(".github/workflows/*.yml") for v in (yaml.safe_load(open(f)).get("jobs") or {}).values()}; need=json.load(open(".github/rulesets/required-checks.json"))["contexts"]; miss=[c for c in need if c not in names]; print(miss); sys.exit(1 if miss else 0)'
python3 -c 'import yaml,sys; t=yaml.safe_load(open(".github/workflows/tests.yml")); a=t["jobs"]["all"]; sys.exit(0 if a.get("if")=="always()" and set(a["needs"])==set(t["jobs"])-{"all"} else 1)'

validation.procedure: Push (gate CI-PUSH); `gh run list --commit $(git rev-parse HEAD) --workflow tests.yml --json conclusion --jq '.[0].conclusion'` and the job list contains `Tests · all lanes` with conclusion success

result.notes: aggregate all в tests.yml/docs.yml, paths убраны из docs.yml/zizmor.yml, required-checks.json создан, codeql name литерал; V5 live ждёт CI-PUSH
deviations: codeql.yml: literal job name for required context
